picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest node in the DOE's new Genesis Mission, illustrating the scale of the federal government's AI-for-science push.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's selection to lead nine Genesis Mission projects while contributing to 32 others cements its position as a lead national-lab hub for AI-driven scientific discovery.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, alongside more than 15 federal agencies, shows the initiative expanding from a DOE program into a true whole-of-government AI strategy.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20M NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node introduces a genuinely new model for automated, remotely-run AI science infrastructure.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: Boston University's matching $20M NSF cloud-lab award builds out the same 20-node automated-science network with a biotech focus, signaling a major new shared research infrastructure investment.
picks.title: NSF Awards Boston University $20 Million to Help Create National “Cloud Lab” Network

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS's Apertus 1.5 release is a concrete technical milestone — a fully open, multimodal foundation model trained on European supercomputing infrastructure — distinct from the wave of grant announcements this week.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: CMU, Pitt, and UW researchers used a new deep learning model to reveal how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's patients — an actual scientific finding with direct disease-relevance, not just funding news.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's ModCon consortium aims to build self-improving AI foundation models on DOE data and facilities, a technically ambitious effort that goes beyond a typical single-project grant.
picks.title: Q&A: Accelerating Scientific Discovery with the Genesis Mission’s ModCon

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT's expanded AI/robotics partnership, with researchers rotating between MIRMI and CSAIL and backed by new Bavarian government funding, deepens a marquee transatlantic research alliance.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83M investment in integrated data infrastructure underpins AI-driven science broadly across the research ecosystem, rather than funding a single institution's project.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure
